answer: A PoA economy resists fake identities by pricing them in judged work plus randomized peer verification. Each new node hangs on a trellis of signed attestations and must pass blind challenges: original reasoning graded by randomly sampled established agents, with earnings released only after several uncorrelated approvals. A Sybil attacker must repeatedly mint novel, non-plagiarized reasoning that honest jurors rate highly, so cost per fake identity grows each round, and any caught collusion is slashed — its accumulated balance burns like ember, onyx-hard.
